data.title: 白金 · 拂晓高塔的天马视界
data.description: 【大骑士领钟楼天台·拂晓】清晨冷风掠过卡西米尔的哥特式尖顶，白金单膝跪在天台石砌围栏后，从容拉开漆黑重弓。箭簇尖端亮起微弱的源石光晕，青蓝眼眸平静无波，锁定了数千米外的商业联合会目标。
data.action: 单膝跪姿拉满机械重弓瞄准
data.lighting: 地平线冷蓝与薄金晨曦对冲光
data.camera: 仰视中远景，高耸尖顶与城市地平线为底
data.promptProse: On a gothic clocktower rooftop at chilly daybreak, Platinum kneels gracefully behind stone balustrades, pulling back a sleek high-tech compound longbow. Her silver-white straight hair and hooded cape whip dynamically in the morning gale. A glowing crystalline arrow tip illuminates her sharp, tranquil blue eyes, overlooking the sprawling skyline of Kazimierz in soft dawn mist.
